decisions.decision: All executor plans run sequentially on the main working tree (no worktree isolation)
decisions.rationale: OpenCode runtime has no worktree isolation for subagents; per execute-phase runtime-compatibility rules executors serialize on the main tree. Waves 4-8 each contain exactly one plan, so nothing loses parallelism.

Verified by source read of bin/lib/state.cjs + bin/lib/state-document.cjs. STATE.md was already consistent (frontmatter 5/10, body 6-of-10, ROADMAP 5/10); skipping preserved it.
